text: Alright team, let's start the weekly engineering standup. Who wants to go first?
I'll go. Yesterday I finished the database migration scripts for the user table. Today I will work on the API integration for the new search endpoint.
My update — I completed the unit tests for the payment module. Coverage is now at 87%. I found two edge cases that need to be fixed before we release.
Good catch Carlos. Can you create Jira tickets for those edge cases and assign them to yourself? We need those resolved before the Thursday release.
Yes will do. I should be able to fix both issues by Wednesday. I'll update the tickets with my progress by end of day.
For my update — I've been blocked on the third-party analytics SDK integration. Their documentation is outdated and I need to contact their support team.
Aisha, please send me the vendor contact details and I will escalate this directly to their account manager. We can't afford a blocker this close to launch.
I can help Aisha with the analytics integration. I've worked with similar SDKs before. Let's pair program on it this afternoon if that works.
That would be really helpful Emily, thank you. Let's do 2pm. I'll send you a calendar invite.
Also, the CI/CD pipeline has been throwing intermittent failures on the main branch. I think it's a flaky test in the integration suite. Should we disable it temporarily?
No, let's not disable it. Carlos, can you take action on investigating the flaky test today? We need the pipeline stable. Add it as a P1 task in Jira.
Understood. I'll take responsibility for the flaky test investigation. Will update the team by 5pm today with my findings.
One more thing — the performance benchmarks for the new search endpoint are looking good. Response time is under 200ms at p99. No action needed there.
Excellent work Emily. Let's make sure we document those benchmarks in the release notes. Can you update the performance doc by tomorrow?
Sure, I will update the performance documentation and share it with the team by tomorrow morning.
Quick note on security — I noticed the API tokens in our staging environment are not rotated regularly. We should implement a rotation policy.
Good point Aisha. Take action on drafting a token rotation policy document and share it with the security team for review by end of week.
Will do. I'll also look into automating the rotation using AWS Secrets Manager. Should have a proposal ready by Friday.

Great. Wrapping up — main action items: Carlos to fix edge cases and investigate flaky tests, Emily to pair with Aisha and update performance docs, Aisha to work on security policy. See everyone tomorrow!
